purpose: Teach: 宮内庁/日夜/儲ける/コネ/ドロップ/修習/総数/産婆

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、宮内庁関連のイベントにも参加しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our company participates in Imperial-related events as well.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Upright posture in the voice. Steady pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone setting a direction without needing to convince.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、日夜、頑張ってくれております
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are working hard day and night.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with quiet pride. Slight warmth beneath the formal register. Steady, reliable rhythm. The assurance of someone backing up their leader's vision.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 儲けるだけでなく、社会貢献も大切ですね
lines.en: It's important that we don't just focus on profit—social contribution matters too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, principled. Pause before the dash to let the shift in values register. Firm but not preachy. Speaking from conviction, not from a script.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いコネを刷新して、新しい人脈を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll refresh our old connections and build new networks.
lines.style: Forward-moving, practical. Slight lift on 'new networks'—the optimism of action. No hesitation. The tone of someone who's already thought through the steps.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトはドロップせずに完遂しましょう
lines.en: Let's see this project through to completion without cutting corners.
lines.style: Firm, precise directive. Weight on 'completion.' Quiet insistence beneath the courtesy. The leader checking for resolve, not asking for permission.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の修習プログラムを充実させました
lines.en: Yes. I've strengthened our newcomer training program.
lines.style: Proud report, understated. The satisfaction of work done well. Even pace, grounded. A moment of quiet competence before moving on.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 総数を正確に集計しましょう
lines.en: Make sure we get the total count exactly right.
lines.style: Precise, attentive. Slight emphasis on 'exactly'—accuracy matters here. Measured pace, no rush. The voice of someone who knows details are where trust is built.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人のサポートは産婆さんのような姿勢で行います
lines.en: Yes. I approach supporting our newcomers the way a midwife approaches her work—with care and patience.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Gentle slowness on the metaphor to let it land. Quiet depth. The voice of someone who's thought carefully about responsibility to others.
